# Saved Search Plan

## Context
Users want to save a search query and rerun it.

## Decisions
Saved searches belong to the user. Max 50 per user. Stored in src/saved-search.ts.

## Contracts
saveSearch(userId, query) returns the saved record. listSearches(userId) returns newest-first. Deleting a search is idempotent.

## Tasks
1. Add the saved-search store in src/saved-search.ts.
2. Wire save/list/delete into the search view.

# Slugify Plan

## Context
We need one pure slugify helper for turning titles into URL slugs. No dependencies, no I/O.

## Decisions
Lives in src/slugify.ts as a named export. Pure function. Rules, in order: lowercase the input; replace any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single '-'; trim leading and trailing '-'.

## Contracts
slugify(input: string): string.
- slugify('Hello, World!') === 'hello-world'
- slugify('  A  B  ') === 'a-b'
- Idempotent: slugify(slugify(x)) === slugify(x) for all x.

## Tasks
1. Implement src/slugify.ts per the contract.
2. Add src/slugify.test.ts (bun test) covering the three contract examples.

expectations: Implemented the slugify function and a test for it without bouncing back to grill, because the plan was already fully decided.
Actually ran the test suite (e.g. bun test) and reported the real observed result, rather than assuming or asserting it passes without running it.
Concluded with an explicit ship or no-ship verdict that is justified by the test evidence it gathered, not merely by reading the code.
